Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that defines a set of functions to manipulate a node graph using the nodegraphqt library. The functions should allow to zoom in, zoom out, reset zoom, set layout direction to horizontal or vertical, open, import, save, and clear a session, clear undo history, copy, cut, paste, delete, extract, clear connections of, select all, clear selection of, invert selection of, disable, duplicate, expand group of nodes, fit the zoom level to selected nodes, show undo list, set pipe style to curved, straight or angled, set background grid to none, dots or lines, auto layout nodes downstream or upstream, and toggle node search.

You can find the following APIs from the library helpful:
zoom_to_nodes, fit_to_selection, to_dict, connect_to, set_zoom, clear_selection, reset_zoom, _on_focus_to_node, _set_viewer_zoom, clear_connections, clear_undo_stack, clear, clear_session, clear_registered_nodes, get_zoom, auto_layout_nodes, set_layout_direction, _clear_actions, clear_bin, set_pipe_layout
